warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Page canvas — the entire site rests on this off-white, never pure #ffffff. Removes clinical SaaS sterility; reads as approachable, paper-like

snow.$description: Snow — Elevated card surfaces, input fields, and light-bordered elements

ink.$description: Ink — Primary body and UI text — the dominant neutral for readable copy across cards, paragraphs, and labels

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Heavier text instances, emphasis copy

fog.$description: Fog — Hairline borders and dividers between sections and cards

slate.$description: Slate — Muted secondary text, body copy in lighter contexts, de-emphasized metadata

slate-border.$description: Slate Border — Stronger borders and link outlines where extra weight is needed

deep-harbor.$description: Deep Harbor — Feature card fills, testimonial card fills, heading text — the dominant dark surface that anchors content blocks against the cream

sky-pop.$description: Sky Pop — Primary action buttons, active states, key emphasis text — the single chromatic accent that drives every interaction

deep-wave.$description: Deep Wave — Outlined link and action border — a darker navy for ghost-style interactive elements that need to read on cream

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Badge and trust-pill backgrounds, soft highlight washes behind icons and social proof

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Button shadow tone — the same hue family used for the chunky pop shadow under sky-blue buttons

info-mist.$description: Info Mist — Blue decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details

sky-mid.$description: Sky Mid — Decorative illustration fills, mid-tone in 3D hero artwork

gilroy.$description: Single-family type system — Gilroy runs at every size from 12px captions to 58px hero headlines. Rounded geometric forms give the brand its friendly financial tone without the stiffness of a grotesque. Weight 700 is the working default for headings and buttons; weight 500 carries UI labels.
